analysis.scoreReason: RSI 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 개선 둔화
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI neutral range consolidation, MACD improvement slowdown

analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold territory but remains consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative, making a trend reversal uncertain. Despite a 5-day uptrend, volume is below average, indicating a lack of conviction.
